behaviour: C1: castVote reserves seq durably (few:poll-vote-seq:{groupId}, per poll and lower-cased own pubkey, never lowered) BEFORE sending; seq = max(stored own, queued own, reservation) + 1. A failed reservation read or write rejects the cast without sending.
C2: a send-succeeded/save-failed cast (or an indeterminate send) is followed by seq + 1, never the same seq.

C3: every stored vote carries receivedAt (local receipt, strictly increasing per page via receiptNow; queued votes keep their queue receipt time). A held creator close tallies only votes with receivedAt <= the earliest creator held close's receivedAt (rows without receivedAt count). close->vote->open and open->close->vote give the same tally.
C4: the poll_close chat gate announces a closed poll's stored results (no vote read); an open poll's tally is recomputed as before.

C5: a live poll_close announcement whose getPoll or loadVotesWithPending fails is held in the existing announcement queue, then the read error is thrown; the next message of the poll replays it. A failed hold is logged and the read error thrown. The unknown-poll branch throws when its hold fails (so a replay keeps the entry).

C6: a live kind-12 close whose getPoll, replay, tally read or closed save fails is held in the pending-close queue (bound to the authenticated sender) and the error rethrown; settleHeldCloses applies it at the next poll message.
C7: removePendingVotes inside replayPendingVotes is best-effort (logged); a read or vote-save failure still throws.
R1-C1: a live close whose held-state recovery is unconfirmed ('unknown') is held and the handler throws.

R1-C2: per voter and poll, votes that can still decide an as-of-receipt tally are kept (queue entries and PollVote.superseded, cap 5); a held creator close counts each voter's newest vote received no later than the close; every arrival order of open/close/changed votes equals the open-first tally.
R1-C3: allocateVoteSeq is an atomic read-max-increment-write returning max(last+1, floor), serialised in-tab and across tabs via Web Locks when available.
R1-C4: receiptNow stays above every receipt handed out before, across reloads and backward clock steps (persisted leased high-water mark).
R1-C5: the poll_close summary gate applies a held close of its poll first (no held-summary replay from there).
non_goals: No change to the dispatcher ack semantics or the rumor journal (a handler throw does not prevent the ack; the held queues are the retry mechanism).
No amendment of a closed poll's tally by a late vote (closing stays final).
No new e2e spec (MLS reordering and storage faults cannot be forced through the app).
No startup sweep of held closes/summaries outside the dispatcher FIFO (lead follow-up).
deviations_from_finding: Finding approach 'count only votes with votedAt <= closedAt' replaced by local receipt order (see report: sender-clock comparison neither converges without amending closed tallies nor resists back-dating).
Finding 2 approach 'rethrow so the journal does not ack' is not available: the dispatcher acks in finally regardless of handler outcome; the held queues are used instead.
Scope extended to the kind-12 live close (C6) and replay clean-up (C7): same lost-on-failure class; without C6 a retried summary could show results for a poll that stays open.
